query: Robert's Plumbing Service Corporation., Hialeah, FL

reviewSamples.author: Cindy O'Donnell
reviewSamples.text: Needed to have utility sink installed, 2 toilets repaired and outside water valves upgraded. Robert's team arrived when he said they would. Very professional and knowledgeable. Work was completed as discussed. No fuss and no mess! Highly recommend Robert's Plumbing Service.

reviewSamples.author: Lillian Bennett
reviewSamples.text: Robert called me back right away. His team came the next day. They did a great job on my leaking toilet. Team was polite. They did not speak English however Robert kept in touch with me the entire time to let me know everything about the repair. Professional and thorough job. I highly recommend!

reviewSamples.author: Elvin Ramirez
reviewSamples.text: We had Robert's Plumbing Service come out this past Saturday, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. They were prompt, professional, and very easy to work with. Everything was explained clearly, and the job was handled quickly and efficiently. I would definitely use Robert's Plumbing Service again in the future and will be recommending them to family and friends.

reviewSamples.author: Kathryn Cadieux
reviewSamples.text: Robert's Plumbing Service was very professional. They did a thorough job and always kept me in the loop. I highly recommend them for all your plumbing needs.

reviewSamples.author: Kyle Miller (Pompano Beach, FL)
reviewSamples.text: This is the fourth project Robert's team have taken care of for me. They are timely, professional, and polite. The work is performed quickly at a fair price. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Robert's Plumbing for all of your plumbing projects. They are truly top notch.
